top_signal.title: Need Advice (thank you)
top_signal.summary: I am a 23M that owns a small design business. Our product is useful for these companies, but not critical. I get all my customers through cold outbound emails, but sometimes referrals as well.    We have an exceptional product, and a 100% satisfaction rate with our customers. They genuinely love my work.    This was my side hustle for 1.5yr, and last month I went full time. Partly because I was getting more business, and partly because my previous job at a small business was falling apart. Needed to leave.   Our AOV is ~ $400. The lowest invoice I send is for $230, and the higher range is ~ $1,000.   The problem I am dealing with is that this market does not have a lot of cash. Even a $230 purchase can be seen as “too expensive”.    I’ve managed to do close to $5,000 in revenue since the start of October. The only costs really are my time, so I are profitable.   I feel stuck in the middle a bit. Our AOV is not high enough to be cool with just a few new clients, and we are too expensive for high volume transactions (also not really set up for it)   One final thought: this is not recurring revenue. It’s design work.. so once the company has it, unless they need it fixed it’s good for extended amount of time.   Has anyone overcome something like this? Feeling awfully stuck. Maybe I need to pivot eventually to a new industry with more available cash?    Any advice / feedback / insights are helpful.       submitted by     /u/Aggravating-Youth990       [link]       [com
